description: ETEngine is Quintel's calculation server for the Energy Transition Model. It exposes a REST API that creates and updates energy scenarios, calculates their balances and returns results to separate user interfaces. The engine reads model data from the ETSource repository; inputs are a dataset, scenario choices and technology settings, while outputs are calculated energy flows and scenario metrics. Spatial and temporal coverage depend on the dataset selected, with the README naming the Netherlands as its default dataset. MIT-licensed source is free and the repository documents Docker installation. A caveat is that the engine alone has no easy front end, and reproducing a run also requires ETSource, a database and application dependencies. It supports energy transition and capacity-planning simulations for the regions encoded in its datasets. The catalogue's model-messageix-framework is a separate scenario tool, not an ETEngine component. This review inspected the public code and setup instructions without installing services or signing in to an administrator account.
name: Energy Transition Engine scenario calculator
notes: G7 G7-1294. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
